requirements.finding: Recommends “migrating away from your current PostgreSQL database” to a proprietary platform. The RFP says “no migration to a new database”.
requirements.suggested_fix: Remove the platform migration and state: “The dashboard connects to your existing PostgreSQL inventory database; no data is migrated.” If a new platform is worth raising, move it to an optional, separately priced “Later phases” note.

requirements.name: Role-based access
requirements.ask: Warehouse managers see only their own site; HQ staff see all sites.
requirements.finding: No user roles or site-level access are described.
requirements.suggested_fix: Add: “Role-based access: warehouse managers see only their own site; HQ staff see all 6 sites.”

requirements.name: Onboarding plan for 6 sites
requirements.ask: A data migration / onboarding plan for all 6 sites with minimal disruption.
requirements.finding: The only migration described is of the data platform. There is no plan for rolling out to the 6 sites with minimal disruption.
requirements.suggested_fix: Add a rollout plan: pilot at one warehouse, a parallel run, then the remaining sites in batches, with dates.

requirements.name: Support & maintenance terms
requirements.ask: Support and maintenance terms after go-live, including response times and SLAs.
requirements.finding: “One year of support” is included, with no response times or SLAs.
requirements.suggested_fix: Add response times per severity and support hours for the included year.

requirements.name: Assumptions, limitations, risks
requirements.ask: Clear documentation of assumptions, limitations or risks, since inventory decisions will rely on the system.
requirements.finding: No risks are disclosed, despite a proposed database migration and an 8-week schedule.
requirements.suggested_fix: Add “Risks & assumptions” covering data migration risk, access to supplier systems for reordering, and how much sales history the forecasting model needs.
